title: Getting started
content:
Install the theme as a Hugo module or git submodule, then run the dev server.
$ git submodule add https://github.com/projectious-work/hugo-theme-projectious.git themes/hugo-theme-projectious $ hugo server ✓ Watching for changes ● Web Server is available at http://localhost:1313/ Info Set theme = &quot;hugo-theme-projectious&quot; in your hugo.toml. Configuration # Copy the [outputs], …

title: Configuration
content:
Theme behavior is controlled through hugo.toml params — no theme fork required.
Param Purpose params.description Default meta description, used when a page has none. params.search.placement &quot;header&quot; (default) or &quot;none&quot; to hide the search box. params.giscus.repo GitHub repo for comments. Leave empty to disable comments site-wide. params.social List of {name, url} links rendered …

title: Shortcodes
content:
Use these to reach further into the brand system without writing HTML.
Callouts # Info Pipeline validation passed all 12 checks. Success Deployment complete. All agents healthy. Warning Agent &ldquo;monitor&rdquo; idle for 2 hours. Danger Policy violation — deployment blocked. Buttons # Primary Accent Outline Ghost Cards # Pipeline config 3 stages · Last run 2h ago Deployment report All 12 checks …

title: Client-side search
content: Added a header search box backed by a small client-side index. No external service, no npm.

title: Specialized beats generic now
content:
Agents collapse the cost of bespoke software. A lot-of-one system, built for one team&rsquo;s exact workflow, is now economically rational.
Underserved teams no longer have to bend themselves to fit generic SaaS or a spreadsheet. The software can fit the team instead.

title: Initial theme release
content: First public version of the theme: docs, blog, changelog, and the full brand component set as shortcodes.

title: Why agent-first?
content:
Do more with more: augment people&rsquo;s strengths so the same or more people produce more, at higher quality, for broader markets.
Quality stays non-negotiable, because agents audit continuously — you ship the same software with continuous review instead of a periodic one.
Provider independence matters too. Agnostic, self-hosted where it counts, so no single AI vendor becomes a single point of …

title: About
content:
projectious.work augments people&rsquo;s strengths so the same or more people can produce more, at higher quality, for broader markets.
Cloud Infrastructure that scales without a dedicated platform team. Agile Delivery rhythms suited to small, fast teams. Agentic AI Agents as a normal part of how good work happens.
